topics.name: button
topics.description: A button's pressed state (Bool From Gamepad). Toggle mode: each press flips open/closed. Hold mode: closed while pressed.

topics.name: trajectory
topics.description: The gripper joint's target: its open or closed position. Wire into the gripper's Joint Controller trajectory.

topics.name: closed
topics.description: Whether the gripper is commanded closed.

joint_id.label: Gripper Joint
joint_id.description: The gripper's DRIVEN joint (the one its motor turns, not a jaw that mimics it). Open and closed are read off its travel limits.

mode.label: Button Mode
mode.description: toggle: each press flips open/closed. hold: closed while the button is held.

start_closed.label: Start Closed
start_closed.description: The state a toggle starts from.

invert.label: Invert
invert.description: Swap open and closed, for a gripper whose closed end is its lower limit.
